label: PF Backlog 489
title: DEFECT: DOGFOOD profile e2e checker is self-referential + scope-hardcoded -> first dogfood can never PASS
body: The DOGFOOD profile e2e checker (_check_e2e, core/validation_engine.py:214-222) is (a) self-referential: it requires a PRIOR recorded DOGFOOD run with result PASS, so the first-ever dogfood can never satisfy it (unknown -> BLOCKED; chicken-and-egg); and (b) scope-hardcoded: it calls list_runs('project', ...), so product_forge-scope dogfood runs are never found (e2e stays unknown even after a PASS). Follow-up to BI-PF-0425 (which implemented the checkers). Fix: use the run's scope, and validate the generated product's actual e2e evidence (or allow an explicit first-run bootstrap => skip). Observed: running the four profiles on an idle checkout yields FAIL with e2e=unknown; DOGFOOD can never reach PASS on a first run.

delivery.note: real product-e2e checker (test_matrix + test_framework_integration); merge --no-ff (no PR)
